text:
maya: Quick mid-quarter ask — can we consider pulling in the cost-savings work (batching + prefix cache v2) and push the new smart-filtering UI to next quarter?

Rationale: finance flagged we’re missing the Q2 unit-cost OKR by ~8%. Batch/cache changes are a smaller scope, high ROI (est. ~10–15% token cost reduction on embeddings/long-form gen). Smart-filtering is valuable but larger and lower immediate cost impact.

devin: need rough eng estimate before sign-off. batch+cache v2 — unoptimized kernel integration + rollout + e2e tests = ~3–4 wks for a small team. Smart-filtering UI = ~6–8 wks.

sam: heads up — batching changes touch served runtime cache invalidation patterns. Risk: slight latency variance for short-SEQ requests during rollout. Can mitigate with canary + traffic ramp.

julia: if we do this swap we need OKR wording updated and a short comms note for CS and growth. Also update roadmap slide for mid-q reforecast.

rachel-finance: if batching/cache v2 ships in Q2 we model ~$120k monthly gross savings at 50% adoption. That gets us roughly to target if rollout meets expectations. Need contingency plan if adoption lags.

maya: thanks. two asks: (1) devin — can you confirm 3–4 wk timeline and list dependencies? (2) sam — outline canary plan + rollback criteria. I want both by EOD tomorrow so we can present at GTM sync Thursday.

devin: will do. blocking deps: kernel flags from eng-runtime (ticket RT-4621), perf testing infra slot, infra quota for additional canary pods.

sam: canary plan: ramp 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 5 days, monitor p50/p95, cache hit ratio, error-rate. rollback if p95 increases >20% or error-rate >0.5% over baseline.

julia: tagging this for OKR adjust cycle. What should objective metric be? Proposed: "Reduce inference token cost by 10% (Q2)."

rachel-finance: confirm: set forecast delta = -$120k/month from Ops savings; add a conservative scenario -$60k if adoption is slower. I also need an owner for tracking actuals weekly.

maya: owner: devin + rachel-finance will own measurement and report weekly. Decision: approve the scope swap contingent on devin + sam deliverables tomorrow. I'll draft the OKR wording and comms once we have numbers.

ops-bot: Deployment window check — next maintenance window available Fri 03:00 UTC.

devin: noted, will try to align canary start with Fri window.

sam: will prepare rollout runbook and post it to #eng-oncall before Friday.

julia: updating the OKR doc now and will link when done.

maya: thanks everyone — moving forward with contingent approval. Will post final confirmation after tomorrow's updates. :thumbsup:
